premises.text: 900 million people spend 20 hours a week acting as if their job is to process their inbox
premises.evidence_span: 900 million people spend 20 hours a week acting as if their job is to process their inbox

premises.text: Priorities come from various sources including emails and thoughts
premises.evidence_span: your inbox has priorities, but so do they come out of your mind, and they come out of meetings

premises.text: Capturing all priorities in one place is necessary for making good decisions
premises.evidence_span: You have to get them all in one place to make good decisions

premises.text: Triage is necessary for making decisions on every item when you see it
premises.evidence_span: Triage is making decisions on every item when you see it

premises.text: Planning is essential for making wise decisions with time
premises.evidence_span: you have to make wise decisions with it, because it will be gone

premises.text: Completing important work is necessary for achieving desired outcomes
premises.evidence_span: Actually do the work that you think is most important until it is complete

premises.text: Handle is the world's first priority engine designed to manage tasks and emails
premises.evidence_span: introducing the world's first priority engine, Handle

premises.text: Handle allows users to capture thoughts and tasks quickly
premises.evidence_span: Handle makes it easy for me to capture my thoughts and get them into my trusted system quickly

premises.text: Email triage is necessary for managing inbox items efficiently
premises.evidence_span: Email triage is where you go to your inbox and you make decisions on everything

premises.text: The Handlebar feature enhances the speed of email triage
premises.evidence_span: we've created a unique element we call the Handlebar

premises.text: Handle's priority list helps users focus on must-do tasks
premises.evidence_span: Handle's priority list is full, is ordered by importance, with must-dos at the top

premises.text: Handle helps users avoid context switching to maintain productivity

value.text: Handle enables users to focus on what is most important and achieve desired outcomes
value.evidence_span: Handle is not about handle. It's about you and doing what you feel is most important
